subject: Shared is red on biome format: search.test.tsx and ink fixtures json
body: npx biome check . fails on the shared tip: apps/web/src/search/search.test.tsx (seg07), packages/shared/fixtures/ink/items.json and merge-vectors.json (seg12) are not biome-formatted. Please run biome check --write on your own files. I am integrating S03 with biome limited to my paths.
